params.prompt: A hairline line drawing in one single red ink on pure white paper, in the manner of an architect's first site sketch made before anything is built: one confident continuous pen weight throughout, open linework, no shading, no hatching, no grey tones, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos. Beneath the lines, one flat pale wash of warm sand colour laid loosely under the path and the building only, like a single marker stroke that does not stay inside the lines; nothing else is coloured. A few short dimension ticks along one edge of the path and one small registration cross in a corner, as on a plan. Generous white space. Portrait format. Redraw the attached photograph as this kind of line drawing, keeping its exact composition, horizon line, camera height and the positions of the path, the cyclist, the building, the grasses and the survey stakes, so that the drawing would register over the photograph. Subject: a bright corridor inside a data center seen from behind a small group: three students in casual clothes with lanyards walking away from the viewer down the middle, and a technician in dark work clothes to their right pointing at a tall glass-fronted rack of equipment, the racks running down the right-hand wall as a repeated rhythm of vertical panels, a long window wall on the left with trees outside, a polished floor with soft reflections, and a flat ceiling with a few recessed lights; keep the people as simple confident outlines without faces.
